regions.evidence: Following complete JMP $DEE6 at physicalDA43..DA45, five compact values then layered little-endian pointer arrays. First text pointer atDA6C encodes CPU9B26 -> physicalDB36 under banks6/7; encoded words from DB36 onward use space80, a..z B4..CD, A..Z9A..B3, low control tokens, and terminators. Complete range inspected for noninstruction patterns; many recognizable rendered Guild/name/ending message fragments, pointer groups and repeated text tokens. Existing classified code ends before range and no observed ROM fetch conflicts. Mixed control streams/pointer data, individual string boundaries not asserted; source lookup consumers ECD2/ECD8 and runtime caption rendering support data role.

Uniform zero suffix after final text/control terminator and before distinct four-byte reset-write stub/vector suffix at10006. regions.label: Bank00_ResetBridge
regions.evidence: Independent reset-bridge contract: entry CPU BFF6 under mode3 lower pair selects this physical tail; SEI then INC FFFF writes high-bit fixed IRQ-vector byte and resets MMC1 control to mode3 while preserving selected lower pair. Three vector words BFF6 also decode as INC zp,X instructions; fallthrough wraps into fixed-bank C000 reset after exactly10bytes. RAM side effects safe under reset contract because reset clears working state. Identical bridge at seven pair tails and each encoded vector targets BFF6 support purposeful dual code/vector role. Natural entry not observed; analysis/round01/reset-bridges.json.
